I promise I’m not trying to be mysterious, I just want to keep things secure. Plus, I don’t want my new cactus neighbors to get jealous of all the attention!

Looks like it’s time for me to brave the wilds of online shopping! Yes, please walk me through how to order the red cotton v-neck in size L. I promise to follow your instructions and not get distracted by cat videos—well, I’ll try my best!

Thank you so much for the step-by-step guide! I’ll follow it like a treasure map—hopefully, the only thing I’ll lose is my old address, not my way through checkout. If I run into any trouble, I’ll be back faster than you can say “salsa stain!” 

Thanks again for all your help and for putting up with my jokes. Have a great day!
